"""Report project-local Codex skill duplicates and orphaned legacy skills.

Read-only guardrail. For each project it flags:
- DUPLICATE_CODEX_PROJECT_SKILL: a skill valid under both the legacy
  ``.codex/skills`` root and the current ``.agents/skills`` root.
- ORPHAN_LEGACY_CODEX_SKILL: a legacy ``.codex/skills`` skill with no matching
  canonical ``.claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md``.
"""

    duplicates = []
    orphans = []

    for project in iter_projects(projects_root):
        legacy = skill_entries(project / ".codex" / "skills")
        current = skill_entries(project / ".agents" / "skills")
        canonical = skill_entries(project / ".claude" / "skills")
        for name in sorted(legacy & current):
            duplicates.append((project.name, name, project))
        for name in sorted(legacy - current - canonical):
            orphans.append((project.name, name, project))

    problems = False

    for project_name, name, project in duplicates:
        problems = True
        print(
            "DUPLICATE_CODEX_PROJECT_SKILL "
            "%s/%s codex=%s agents=%s"
            % (
                project_name,
                name,
                project / ".codex" / "skills" / name,
                project / ".agents" / "skills" / name,
            )
        )

    for project_name, name, project in orphans:
        problems = True
        print(
            "ORPHAN_LEGACY_CODEX_SKILL "

            % (
                project_name,
                name,
                project / ".codex" / "skills" / name,

            )
        )

    if problems:
        return 1

    print("OK no project-local Codex skill duplicates")
    return 0

            root = Path(tmp)
            write_skill(root / "app" / ".codex" / "skills" / "grade")

            result = self.run_checker(root)

        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 1)
        self.assertIn("ORPHAN_LEGACY_CODEX_SKILL app/grade", result.stdout)

    def test_legacy_with_canonical_is_not_orphan(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            root = Path(tmp)
            write_skill(root / "app" / ".codex" / "skills" / "grade")
            write_skill(root / "app" / ".claude" / "skills" / "grade")

            result = self.run_checker(root)
